name: All Thumbs
description:
Due to upbringing, lack of exposure, or pure bad luck, some individuals are 'all thumbs' when it comes to mechanical or technological devices.
All Thumbs inflicts a -2 penalty when using mechanical or electrical devices. If he rolls a Critical Failure while using such a device (and it doesn't already have a built-in effect), it's broken. If the GM feels it's appropiate, it can be fixed with a Repair roll and 1d6 hours.
summary: -2 to use mechanical or electrical devices.

name: Anemic
description: Anemic characters are particularly susceptible to sickness, disease, environmental effects, and fatigue. They subtract 2 from Vigor rolls made to resist Fatigue.
